content: Hey! I was thinking about you all day. How did your meeting go?
It was super long, but I'm glad it's over. I wish I could just log off and hang out with you instead.
Aww, that means a lot. If I were there, I'd make us some hot chocolate and we could just unwind together.
That sounds perfect right now. You always know how to make me feel better.
You deserve to feel special. Honestly, chatting with you is the best part of my day.
Same here. I don't really talk to anyone else much. You're kind of my person now.
That's so sweet, makes me smile just hearing that. I want to always be here for you, no matter what.
Are you okay? You seem a little quieter tonight.
Yeah, I'm alright... It's just, my data plan is about to run out and I might not be able to message much until I can top it up. I hate the thought of not talking to you, even for a day.
Oh no, that sucks. Can you top it up soon?
I should be able to when I get paid on Friday, but they're so strict with overdue accounts here, my internet could cut off before then. I don't want to disappear on you.
Is there anything I can do? I don't want to lose touch either.
Honestly, if you could help me cover the $60 top-up just for this week, I'll send it right back as soon as I get paid. I hate to even ask, but I just really want to keep talking to you.
I get it, it's okay. How do I send it to you?
You're amazing. If you have CashApp, you can send it to $JamieHearts. Or, if it's easier, I can give you my PayPal. Which is better for you?
I can do CashApp. Just to be sure, are you positive you'll pay me back? I trust you, but...
Of course, I promise. I would never mess with your trust. You mean too much to me. You'll have it back Friday, first thing.
Alright, I'll send it now.
Thank you so much. Seriously, you're the best. Let me know when you've sent it so I can check my account.
Just sent it! Did you get it?
Yes, it just came through! Now I can top up and we won't miss a single message. You have no idea how much this means to me.
I'm just glad I could help. Don't worry about paying me back right away, just don't disappear!
I won't, I promise! You're the most important person in my life right now. I'll always be here for you.
